commands: set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state | grep -qx device; OUT=/data/local/tmp/aicall_bg_probe.txt; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell rm -f "$OUT"; T0=$(python3 -c 'import time; print(time.monotonic())'); adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "sh -c 'sleep 2; echo background_survived=1 > $OUT' >/dev/null 2>&1 </dev/null &"; T1=$(python3 -c 'import time; print(time.monotonic())'); RETURN_MS=$(python3 -c "print(round(($T1-$T0)*1000))"); echo adb_shell_return_ms=$RETURN_MS; sleep 3; RESULT=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cat "$OUT" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' || true); printf '%s\n' "$RESULT"; test "$RESULT" = "background_survived=1"; test "$RETURN_MS" -lt 1500; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell rm -f "$OUT"; echo background_observer_probe_green=true
